# My QWinUI3 app (generated by qwinui3 init)

## Build (Release)

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<Qt>
cmake --build build --config Release
```

Adjust `QWINUI3_ROOT` if this folder is not a sibling of the QWinUI3 clone.

## Run

```bash
./build/my_qwinui3_app   # or build\Release\my_qwinui3_app.exe
```

Docs: https://wuyijing-dev.github.io/QWinui3/getting-started.html
